answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 37227 Country: India Title: I need dua for my nephew. His name is Mohammed Fahad of 5 years, he is very naughty and does not listen to us Question: I need dua for my nephew. His name is Mohammed Fahad of 5 years, he is very naughty and does not listen to us. My bhabi is very worried about him. Please, kindly suggest me a dua. Answer ID: 37227 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 491/228/L=1433) Ask your bhabi to recite the following ayah extensively and supplicate for her child, especially after each salah: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
